这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的 QWEN Image Edit Plus (2511) 工作流程，它将使用非常简单的自然语言文本编辑指令来微编辑所需的图像以删除对象，同时使用 prithivMLmods 的 Qwen Image Edit 2511 Object Remover LORA 保留背景、灯光和周围元素，保持真实感和原始细节。这是我的旧版 QWEN 图像编辑工作流程的更新和扩展版本，您可以在我的 CivitAI 个人资料中找到它。您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载必要的 QWEN 图像文件（详细信息如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、HiDream、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN v2、Z-Image Turbo、Chroma、AuraFlow、Ovis Image、Flux 和 其他的。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 QWEN Image 型号

#2.现在在“上传用于删除对象的图像”中选择您的图像

＃3。在下一步中输入您的图像编辑说明

＃4。然后选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。之后选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃5。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly QWEN Image Edit Plus (2511) workflow that will work with very simple text editing instructions in natural language to micro edit your desired image to remove object(s) while preserving the background, lighting and surrounding elements maintaining realism and original details using Qwen Image Edit 2511 Object Remover LORA by prithivMLmods. This is an updated and extended version of my older QWEN Image Edit Workflow that you can find in my CivitAI Profile. You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary QWEN Image files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, HiDream, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN v2, Z-Image Turbo, Chroma, AuraFlow, Ovis Image, Flux & others.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired QWEN Image models first

#2. now select your image on "Upload image for Object(s) Removal"

#3. on next step enter your image editing instructions

#4. then select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. after this select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#5. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..
